say:11:1211113010:0.text: We've all been seeing weird stuff during this journey... Could it be something in the food we ate last night?
say:11:1211113010:0.source_cn: 这一路走来，大家都出现了各种各样的幻觉……难道是昨晚吃...

say:12:1211113011:0.text: Then hallucinations would've occurred before we reached this point.
say:12:1211113011:0.source_cn: 那早该出现幻觉了才对。

say:14:1211113012:0.text: Ahhh, I'm so curious! What does my spirit look like? Was I translucent? Did I have a super pale face? What was I doing? Did I say hi to you?
say:14:1211113012:0.source_cn: 幽灵的“我”是什么样？\n半透明的吗？脸惨白吗？我在做...

say:17:1211113014:0.text: I'm starting to think that this might be a new trial set up by that fairy.
say:17:1211113014:0.source_cn: 我在想，这说不定是那个喜欢捉弄人的妖精，为我们临时加码...

say:18:1211113015:0.text: Sinbad and I both saw spirits of our loved ones. Could she be testing us?
say:18:1211113015:0.source_cn: 因为我和辛巴达看到的，全都是“亲人”的幽灵。她是不是在...

say:19:1211113016:0.text: Is this a fourth trial? I thought we only had three trials?
say:19:1211113016:0.source_cn: 第四场试炼吗……没听说过。

say:20:1211113017:0.text: If this is truly a trial, we have no choice but to face it head-on.
say:20:1211113017:0.source_cn: 事到如今，如果这真的是试炼，也只能面对了。

say:21:1211113018:0.text: Don't overthink it. Let's stay focused and move forward.
say:21:1211113018:0.source_cn: 多想无益，打起精神前进吧。

say:24:1211113006:0.text: Was it really just an illusion? But other than that, there doesn't seem to be a more reasonable explanation...
say:24:1211113006:0.source_cn: 真的是幻觉吗？不过，除此之外好像也没有更合理的解释了。
say:24:1211113006:0.male: Was it really just an illusion? But other than that, there doesn't seem to be a more reasonable explanation...
say:24:1211113006:0.female: Was it really just an illusion? But other than that, there doesn't seem to be a more reasonable explanation...

say:25:1211113007:0.text: I mean... the real Nara is here. What we saw was <style="highlight">her spirit</style>.
say:25:1211113007:0.male: I mean... the real Nara is here. What we saw was <style="highlight">her spirit</style>.
say:25:1211113007:0.female: I mean... the real Nara is here. What we saw was <style="highlight">her spirit</style>.

say:3:1211117001:0.text: I can't believe we actually defeated Hodgkin!
say:3:1211117001:0.source_cn: 我们打败了霍德希金……真不敢相信！我们居然打败了霍德希金！

say:4:1211117002:0.source_cn: 那可是率领着死潮舰队的大海盗！

say:5:1211117003:0.text: Sinbad, why didn't you tell us that Hodgkin could turn into a spirit?
say:5:1211117003:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，你从来没说过霍德希金还能变成幽灵啊？

say:7:1211117005:0.text: Wasn't the Hodgkin we just fought a spirit?
say:7:1211117005:0.source_cn: 刚刚和我们战斗的霍德希金，不是个幽灵吗？

say:8:1211117006:0.text: He did look like a spirit!

say:11:1211117007:0.text: Magister, did you notice anything unusual?
say:11:1211117007:0.male: Magister, did you notice anything unusual?
say:11:1211117007:0.female: Magister, did you notice anything unusual?

choice_prompt:12:1211117007.text: Magister, did you notice anything unusual?
choice_prompt:12:1211117007.male: Magister, did you notice anything unusual?
choice_prompt:12:1211117007.female: Magister, did you notice anything unusual?

say:15:1211117008:0.text: I'm confused. I think I saw Hodgkin himself.
say:15:1211117008:0.source_cn: 我不懂你们在说什么，我看到的是霍德希金本人。

choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 索尼娅看到的是什么样子？

say:18:1211117009:0.text: I saw what Chippy saw! Instead of a spirit, I think it was more like Hodgkin's phantom.
say:18:1211117009:0.source_cn: 我和满满看到的一样。但我认为与其说是幽灵，应该把他称为...

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 漫漫看到的是什么样子？

say:22:1211117010:0.text: The three of us saw something different from the magister... Is it like what Hammie said? Do mages have the ability to see through illusions?
say:22:1211117010:0.source_cn: 只有我们三个和梅林看到的不一样……难道就像漫漫说的，是...
say:22:1211117010:0.male: The three of us saw something different from the magister... Is it like what Hammie said? Do mages have the ability to see through illusions?
say:22:1211117010:0.female: The three of us saw something different from the magister... Is it like what Hammie said? Do mages have the ability to see through illusions?

say:26:1211117012:0.text: As the magister regains more power, it makes sense that he can see through illusions and discern the truth.
say:26:1211117012:0.source_cn: 按理说，主人寻回的力量越来越多了，确实可以看破幻象，洞...
say:26:1211117012:0.male: As the magister regains more power, it makes sense that he can see through illusions and discern the truth.
say:26:1211117012:0.female: As the magister regains more power, it makes sense that she can see through illusions and discern the truth.

say:27:1211117013:0.text: Hodgkin's corpse disappeared too... and there are no traces of our fight anywhere.
say:27:1211117013:0.source_cn: 霍德希金的尸体也消失了……周围好像也没留下打斗的痕迹。

say:28:1211117014:0.text: I swear I felt his hook slice through me... Was such a vivid battle really just an illusion?
say:28:1211117014:0.source_cn: 我明明能感觉到他的勾手划过身体……那么真实的战斗，竟然...

say:29:1211117015:0.text: It takes incredible power to conjure an illusion this realistic...
say:29:1211117015:0.source_cn: 想要营造如此真实的幻觉，需要非常强大的力量。

choice_prompt:30:1211117015.text: It takes incredible power to conjure an illusion this realistic...
choice_prompt:30:1211117015.source_cn: 想要营造如此真实的幻觉，需要非常强大的力量。

say:31:1211117016:0.text: If Tasi is the one behind all these, she must be something special...
say:31:1211117016:0.source_cn: 要是塔西能做到这种事……她的身份一定不简单。

say:33:1211117018:0.text: Arrrghh! I can't wrap my head around this! Let's just grab the treasure and get the heck out of this cursed place!
say:33:1211117018:0.source_cn: 啊啊啊——想不明白！早点拿到宝藏，早点离开这个鬼地方吧。

say:35:1211117017:0.text: I didn't know the god of the waves was skilled at creating illusions. I don't recall reading anything like that...
say:35:1211117017:0.source_cn: 风浪与漂泊之神擅长营造幻象吗？我似乎没看过类似的记载……

choice:12:2:3.source_cn: 我和漫漫满满，与你们看到的不一样

say:2:1211118001:0.text: So there really is a treasure...

say:3:1211118002:0.text: Ah, a ship! I love it! It's mine now!
say:3:1211118002:0.source_cn: 我喜欢这艘船。从现在起，它是我的了！

say:7:1211118003:0.text: This bottle reminds me of the drift bottles from fairy tales.
say:7:1211118003:0.source_cn: 这个瓶子……好像童话书上的漂流瓶。

say:8:1211118004:0.text: It's so big... Only a giant could make a bottle this size, right?
say:8:1211118004:0.source_cn: 它也太大了……只有巨人才会做这么大的漂流瓶吧？

say:9:1211118005:0.text: The drift bottles that Chippy found usually contain things like sand, flowers, and notes.
say:9:1211118005:0.source_cn: 漂流瓶里一般装的都是沙子、纸星星、花，或者是卷起来的信。

say:10:1211118006:0.text: What kind of bottle contains a ship?
say:10:1211118006:0.source_cn: 什么样的漂流瓶会装船呢？

say:15:1211118008:0.text: Let me take a look at those small bottles scattered around.
say:15:1211118008:0.source_cn: 旁边散落着一些小的漂流瓶，我去看看。

say:2:1211119001:1.text: It's a painting of Ryeham and Mirael!
say:2:1211119001:1.source_cn: 画上是金穗村和米瑞尔！
say:2:1211119001:1.male: It's a painting of Ryeham and Mirael!
say:2:1211119001:1.female: It's a painting of Ryeham and Mirael!

say:4:1211119002:0.text: Be careful, this might be another illusion.
say:4:1211119002:0.source_cn: 梅林……小心啊，这说不定又是幻觉。
say:4:1211119002:0.male: Be careful, this might be another illusion.
say:4:1211119002:0.female: Be careful, this might be another illusion.

say:1:1211120001:1.text: Wait, is that Eironn in the painting?!

say:3:1211120002:0.text: Magister, Chippy can't believe his eyes!
say:3:1211120002:0.source_cn: 主人……满满有点不敢相信自己的眼睛了！
say:3:1211120002:0.male: Magister, Chippy can't believe his eyes!
say:3:1211120002:0.female: Magister, Chippy can't believe his eyes!

say:2:1211121001:1.text: Is that the Remnant Peaks in the painting?
say:2:1211121001:1.source_cn: 上面画的是遗迹群山吗？

say:4:1211121002:0.text: There's also the giant golem summoned by Illucia! Oh, that was a nightmare...
say:4:1211121002:0.source_cn: 还有黑金女士召唤的巨大魔偶……那真是一场噩梦。

say:5:1211121003:0.text: Now it feels like we're caught in another one!
say:5:1211121003:0.source_cn: 我觉得现在也像是一场噩梦了！

say:3:1211122001:0.text: It looks like the paintings in these bottles depict our past experiences...
say:3:1211122001:0.source_cn: 这些漂流瓶里的画卷，好像都是我们经历过的事情？

say:4:1211122002:0.text: Sinbad, did you find anything that relates to you?
say:4:1211122002:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，你也找到了瓶中画吗？

say:5:1211122003:0.text: Yes... This figure in the painting is definitely my old man, from the day he left.
say:5:1211122003:0.source_cn: 是的……画面上那个背影，一看就是我老爹，在他走的那天。

say:6:1211122004:0.text: I will never forget that day... It's a memory that's uniquely mine.
say:6:1211122004:0.source_cn: 我永远记得他留给我的背影……这是独属于我的记忆。

say:10:1211122006:0.text: The paintings on these bottles show things from many years ago that I've never mentioned to anyone.
say:10:1211122006:0.source_cn: 画上都是很多年前的事，我从没对别人提起过。

say:11:1211122007:0.text: Just like the paintings we found, they show the journey we experienced with the magister!
say:11:1211122007:0.source_cn: 我们的画也一样，描绘着我们与梅林曾经经历过的旅程——
say:11:1211122007:0.male: Just like the paintings we found, they show the journey we experienced with the magister!
say:11:1211122007:0.female: Just like the paintings we found, they show the journey we experienced with the magister!

say:12:1211122008:0.text: But only the events after he <style="highlight">lost his memory</style>. They don't depict the legendary adventures he had before that.
say:12:1211122008:0.male: But only the events after he <style="highlight">lost his memory</style>. They don't depict the legendary adventures he had before that.
say:12:1211122008:0.female: But only the events after she <style="highlight">lost her memory</style>. They don't depict the legendary adventures she had before that.

say:13:1211122009:0.text: Speaking of which... Could it be that these bottles capture the <style="highlight">memories</style> of the one who opens them?
say:13:1211122009:0.source_cn: 说到失忆……难道这瓶子里呈现的，是拾取之人的<styl...

say:14:1211122010:0.text: The bottle I opened shows scenes from my childhood with Nara, and my later experiences with the Carmine Whispers.
say:14:1211122010:0.source_cn: 我打开的瓶子里，画着奈拉和我的童年，还有长大后，我在血...

say:15:1211122011:0.text: But Nara's bottle only shows our childhood days.
say:15:1211122011:0.source_cn: 而奈拉打开的瓶子里，只画着我们小时候的事。

say:16:1211122012:0.text: In this painting, my old man is wearing a patched vest. It was his favorite piece, but I accidentally ruined it before he left.
say:16:1211122012:0.source_cn: 我画里的老爹，穿了一件打了补丁的马甲。那是他最喜欢的衣...

say:17:1211122013:0.text: So he couldn't possibly wear that out at sea. Now that I think about it, the painting is really just <style="highlight">my memory of him</style>, always in that vest...
say:17:1211122013:0.source_cn: 他不可能穿着那件马甲出海，但在画里他穿了那件马甲。仔细...

say:18:1211122014:0.text: The paintings here are just reading <style="highlight">our memories</style>...

say:20:1211122015:0.text: That's why the painting in the magister's bottle only shows experiences from Ryeham onward.
say:20:1211122015:0.source_cn: 原来是这样，所以主人的瓶中画只有从金穗村开始的经历啊。
say:20:1211122015:0.male: That's why the painting in the magister's bottle only shows experiences from Ryeham onward.
say:20:1211122015:0.female: That's why the painting in the magister's bottle only shows experiences from Ryeham onward.

say:21:1211122016:0.text: So that's how it is. It's all like the dreams I used to have... but now everything just blends together.
say:21:1211122016:0.source_cn: 一切都像是我过去经常会做的梦，所有的内容都混淆到了一起……

say:22:1211122017:0.text: I get that feeling too. Ever since we entered this cave, things have been getting increasingly unrealistic.
say:22:1211122017:0.source_cn: 我也有这种混沌感。从进入洞穴开始，现实变得愈加不真切了。

choice_prompt:23:1211122017.text: I get that feeling too. Ever since we entered this cave, things have been getting increasingly unrealistic.
choice_prompt:23:1211122017.source_cn: 我也有这种混沌感。从进入洞穴开始，现实变得愈加不真切了。

say:2:1211124001:0.text: The moment you stepped onto the island, you entered Ulmus' dream. This is also where the treasure is.
say:2:1211124001:0.source_cn: 这里确实是梦境，也是藏宝之地。从你们登上小岛的那一刻起...

say:3:1211124002:0.text: Ulmus... isn't this the name of the tree?

say:4:1211124003:0.text: Exactly! You have an excellent memory!
say:4:1211124003:0.source_cn: 哎呀，真可爱！你的记性真好。

say:5:1211124004:0.text: Let me reintroduce myself! I'm Tasi, sometimes known as <style="highlight">the fairy of dreams</style>. As you may have guessed, I'm the guardian of this place.
say:5:1211124004:0.source_cn: 那么，让我重新做个自我介绍吧。我是这里的保卫者，<st...

say:6:1211124005:0.text: Following Tritonus' orders, Ulmus and I guard the treasure he hid within the realm of dreams.
say:6:1211124005:0.source_cn: 奉特勒米琉斯的嘱托，我和奥曼斯在此地守护着风浪与漂泊之...

say:7:1211124006:0.text: Brave adventurers, you've demonstrated your will and strength. As a reward, I will give you the treasure.
say:7:1211124006:0.source_cn: 各位冒险家，你们证明了自己的意志与实力，因此，我会将宝...

say:8:1211124007:0.text: It will be something you <style="highlight">long for the most</style>. The thing that <style="highlight">dwells within your deepest dreams</style>.
say:8:1211124007:0.source_cn: 那将是各位<style=highlight>最想要的东...

say:12:1211124009:0.text: Oh, poor little thing... It almost hurts me to tell you that you don't get to pick the treasure.
say:12:1211124009:0.source_cn: 唉，可怜又可爱的小家伙……虽然这么说很可惜，但是你没有...

say:13:1211124010:0.text: But don't you worry! Your sister will definitely get what she wants!
say:13:1211124010:0.source_cn: 但是别担心！你的姐姐一定能拿到她想要的东西！

say:17:1211124012:0.text: Take your reward before you ask any questions.
say:17:1211124012:0.source_cn: 提问之前，先拿走你们的奖品吧。

say:18:1211124013:0.text: So, Sonja, tell me what you've always wished for.
say:18:1211124013:0.source_cn: 来吧，索尼娅，告诉我，你的梦寐之物是什么？

say:19:1211124014:0.text: What is it that you see right now?
say:19:1211124014:0.source_cn: 此时此刻你的眼中，看到了什么？

say:20:1211124015:0.text: A staff symbolizing the power of the Carmine Whispers, and...
say:20:1211124015:0.source_cn: 你是说……这柄血蔷薇权杖？和……

say:21:1211124016:0.text: And? Remember, your treasure is something only you can see.
say:21:1211124016:0.source_cn: 和什么呢？你的宝藏，只有你自己能看到哦。

say:22:1211124017:0.text: Nara's bow and a paper boat she made...
say:22:1211124017:0.source_cn: 另一个，是奈拉的蝴蝶结和她折的纸船……

say:23:1211124018:0.text: Is it a hard choice? Have you been struggling with how to choose all this time?
say:23:1211124018:0.source_cn: 很难抉择吗？直到现在，你都在纠结应该怎么选？

say:25:1211124020:0.text: Don't be greedy. I can't give you everything. Please pick the one you want the most.
say:25:1211124020:0.source_cn: 可不能贪心哦，我不能全都给你，只能给你最想要的那一个。

say:26:1211124021:0.text: I've made up my mind. My life won't change based on the choice I make here.
say:26:1211124021:0.source_cn: ……不必了。我的人生，不会因为在这里做出选择而有所改变。

say:27:1211124022:0.text: I have to take Nara back to Rustport and fight off the Dead Tide Fleet. No matter what choice I make, it won't change what I have to do next.
say:27:1211124022:0.source_cn: 我要带奈拉回锈锚港，赶走死潮舰队。无论怎么选，都不会影...

say:28:1211124023:0.text: How interesting... It's the first time I've met someone willing to forgo the treasure.
say:28:1211124023:0.source_cn: 有意思……第一次碰到愿意放弃宝藏的人。

say:29:1211124024:0.text: Since you've made your decision, I wish you luck.
say:29:1211124024:0.source_cn: 我不会强迫你，既然你已经做出了你的选择，祝你好运。

say:30:1211124025:0.text: But since you've completed the trial, if you need it, you can take the chest of gold at my feet.
say:30:1211124025:0.source_cn: 但你毕竟完成了试炼，要是需要的话，就把我脚下这箱金子拿去吧。

say:31:1211124026:0.source_cn: 那么，接下来，到你了——辛巴达！

say:34:1211124027:0.text: I'm nervous... I wonder what kind of treasure I'll get.
say:34:1211124027:0.source_cn: 好紧张……不知道会得到什么样的宝物。

say:35:1211124028:0.source_cn: 瞧，你左边是堆成金山般的财宝，右边是堆成银山般的财宝。...

say:36:1211124029:0.text: Huh, gold and silver...? Isn't it all just money?
say:36:1211124029:0.source_cn: 等等……金山？银山？不都是钱吗？

say:37:1211124030:0.source_cn: 怎么了，你一直以来想要的不是财富吗？

say:38:1211124031:0.source_cn: 有了这些钱，别说是庄园，连城堡都能买下来。你可以让自己...

say:41:1211124034:0.text: Money... I've always wanted money... She's right...
say:41:1211124034:0.source_cn: 钱……没错……钱。我一直都想要钱……

say:42:1211124035:0.text: Mmhmm. Trust me, you won't regret this.

choice_prompt:43:1211124035.text: Mmhmm. Trust me, you won't regret this.
choice_prompt:43:1211124035.source_cn: 对，就是这样。相信我，你不会后悔。

say:45:1211124037:0.text: Oh my, I almost walked right into her trap. Good thing you yelled...

say:45:1211124037:0.female: Oh my, I almost walked right into her trap. Good thing you yelled...

say:46:1211124039:0.text: I've made up my mind! I know what I truly want!
say:46:1211124039:0.source_cn: 我想清楚了！我知道自己真正想要的是什么！

say:47:1211124040:0.text: You know you can't change your mind, right?

say:48:1211124041:0.text: You didn't even give me a real choice.
say:48:1211124041:0.source_cn: 不是反悔，而是你并没有把真正的选项摆在我面前，对吧？

say:49:1211124042:0.text: What I want most... isn't money.

say:11:1211131006:0.source_cn: 这是怎么回事？等一下，她不是和我们一起去寻宝了吗？

say:12:1211131007:0.text: I'm sure she was with Sonja the whole time...?
say:12:1211131007:0.source_cn: 她一直跟着索尼娅，直到刚才……？

say:17:1211131010:0.text: Did your sister rise from the waves like a ghost or something?!

say:19:1211131012:0.text: Then how do you explain the Nara we saw?
say:19:1211131012:0.source_cn: 啊？那我们看见的奈拉到底是——

choice_prompt:20:1211131012.text: Then how do you explain the Nara we saw?
choice_prompt:20:1211131012.source_cn: 啊？那我们看见的奈拉到底是——

say:21:1211131013:0.text: If everything that happened back there was a dream, then why do I have this compass in my hand?
say:21:1211131013:0.source_cn: 你说藏梦岛的探险之旅，其实只是一场梦？那为什么我手里多...

say:24:1211131014:0.text: What happened in the dream was real for us because we were in it.
say:24:1211131014:0.source_cn: 因为我们进入了梦中，梦中发生的一切，对我们来说都是真实的。

say:25:1211131015:0.text: But Graveborns don't dream, so the real Nara was asleep here and didn't actually enter the dream with us.
say:25:1211131015:0.source_cn: 至于奈拉……亡灵是不会做梦的，所以真正的奈拉，一直在海...

say:27:1211131016:0.text: Then how come we still saw Nara in there?
say:27:1211131016:0.source_cn: 那我们为什么还见到了奈拉？

say:28:1211131017:0.text: It might be because of my memories and desires. I've always wanted to see Nara as a child, so she appeared in the dream.
say:28:1211131017:0.source_cn: 记忆……还有执念。我一直想见到小时候的奈拉，所以她在梦...

say:29:1211131018:0.text: I can't believe my wish was granted like this... How could the fairy be so cruel?
say:29:1211131018:0.source_cn: 竟然以这种方式实现我的愿望，妖精真是残忍。

say:30:1211131019:0.text: Sorry, I need a moment to myself. You guys go ahead and board the ship.
say:30:1211131019:0.source_cn: 抱歉，我想静一会儿，先上船吧。

say:33:1211131020:0.text: *Sigh* Sonja didn't want any treasure. I guess seeing the fake Nara was her way of getting what she wanted.
say:33:1211131020:0.source_cn: 唉……索尼娅没要任何宝藏，假奈拉的出现，算是实现了她的...

say:34:1211131021:0.text: The Nara who went through the trials and adventures with us will always live on in our memories.
say:34:1211131021:0.source_cn: 和我们一起经历了试炼与冒险的奈拉，会永远活在我们的记忆中。

say:35:1211131022:0.text: Even though Graveborns don't dream, maybe Nara's spirit and our dreams merged at some point.
say:35:1211131022:0.source_cn: 亡灵虽然不会做梦，说不定，奈拉的意识和我们的梦境……在...

say:36:1211131023:0.text: After all, anything can happen in the Dream Isle, right?
say:36:1211131023:0.source_cn: 毕竟这里是藏梦岛，什么都有可能发生，不是吗？

choice:20:0:1.text: She could be a part of the dream.
choice:20:0:1.male: She could be a part of the dream.
choice:20:0:1.female: She could be a part of the dream.

choice:20:1:2.text: A physical manifestation of Sonja's dream.
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 是索尼娅的梦化为了实体
choice:20:1:2.male: A physical manifestation of Sonja's dream.
choice:20:1:2.female: A physical manifestation of Sonja's dream.

choice:7:0:1.text: Nara has been here the whole time?
choice:7:0:1.male: Nara has been here the whole time?
choice:7:0:1.female: Nara has been here the whole time?

say:38:1211131005:0.text: Not even a flutter of her eyelids!
say:38:1211131005:0.source_cn: 绝、绝对！我一直盯着她，她连眼皮都没有睁开过！

cinematic_dialogue:2:1211114001:.text: Hodgkin?! Did he find the treasure first?!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1211114001:.source_cn: 霍德希金！难道他比我们先找到宝藏了？

cinematic_dialogue:2:1211114002:.text: That's impossible. How did he get here?
cinematic_dialogue:2:1211114002:.source_cn: 不可能……他怎么会来到这里？

cinematic_dialogue:2:1211114003:.text: Hmph... Are you surprised to see me?

say:6:1211115001:0.text: Even if you escape to the ends of the earth, you can't escape from me!
say:6:1211115001:0.source_cn: 就算跑到天涯海角，弱小的虫子终究无法逃出我的手心！

say:7:1211115002:0.text: You were following us all along?!

say:9:1211115003:0.text: How did he do that without anyone noticing?
say:9:1211115003:0.source_cn: 他究竟是从什么时候开始跟踪的？为什么没有任何一个人察觉到！

say:11:1211115004:0.text: Sonja, who is this guy? He just popped outta nowhere!
say:11:1211115004:0.source_cn: 索尼娅姐姐！这是谁？他是从哪里冒出来的？

say:12:1211115005:0.text: Don't worry. I won't let him take you from me again!
say:12:1211115005:0.source_cn: 别怕，我不会让他又一次把你抢走！

say:15:1211115006:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stay alert! That's Hodgkin, the captain of <style="highlight">the Immortal</style> and the leader of the Dead Tide Fleet!
say:15:1211115006:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stay alert! That's Hodgkin, the captain of <style="highlight">the Immortal</style> and the leader of the Dead Tide Fleet!
say:15:1211115006:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stay alert! That's Hodgkin, the captain of <style="highlight">the Immortal</style> and the leader of the Dead Tide Fleet!

say:16:1211115007:0.text: That dirty sea dog! Was it all part of his plan? He's been waiting for us to fall into his trap!
say:16:1211115007:0.source_cn: 这个混账！一切都是他计划好的吗……他早就埋伏在这里了，...

say:17:1211115008:0.text: Hodgkin, don't even think about stopping us!
say:17:1211115008:0.source_cn: 霍德希金，你别想阻拦我们！

say:21:1211115010:0.text: I could wipe you out with a wave of my hand!
say:21:1211115010:0.source_cn: 区区虫子，我挥挥手就能让你们灰飞烟灭！

narration:23:12011126:0.text: At last, you reach the end of the cave, where a phantom is already waiting for you. Sinbad and Sonja recognize him as Hodgkin.
narration:23:12011126:0.source_cn: 你们终于来到了洞穴的终点，一道幻影却早已在此等待。辛巴...

subtitle:1:1211087007:.text: I'll leave it in your hands.
subtitle:1:1211087007:.source_cn: 那就交给你了，我的孩子
subtitle:1:1211087007:.male: I'll leave it in your hands.
subtitle:1:1211087007:.female: I'll leave it in your hands.
